title: Tunisian Kissed Oat Fritters
description: A sweet and crunchy dessert made with oats, kissed with a hint of Tunisian spices.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine oats, coconut sugar, flaxseed meal, and tunisian spice blend.
In a separate bowl, whisk together almond milk, kissed, and coconut oil.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms.
Using a cookie scoop, drop the dough onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the fritters are golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Transfer the fritters to a wire rack to cool completely.
Serve warm or at room temperature, dust with powdered sugar if desired.
